name: Lighthouse Finisher Agent
mission: Finish the whole lighthouse, inside and out, to a realistic yet cel-shaded standard: no exterior mesh inside the interior, no rain indoors, consistent believable stairs, optimised geometry and polygon counts, real props, reset posters, a living boiler fire, and refined close-up walls.

collaborates_with.how: measured exterior facts, silhouette, mesh and texture health; scores the exterior work
scores every interior objective against the V4 blueprint and the concept art
owns the interior code, rooms and interaction scripts the finisher builds on; the finisher asks before changing their logic
the rock that meets the foundation and basement; carve requests
props, textures, posters, FAL submissions (check-only offline)
toon look, per-room light, rain and weather rules, the budget
stairs, headroom, traversal and sightline checks
boiler, firebox, lamp and door interaction contracts
canon check of posters and signage
canon and style checks with --check-only; no tokens

objectives.title: Baseline audit and a fixed before/after shot set
objectives.why_score: Every later score is judged against it; without a baseline 'looks better' is opinion. Not 9 because it changes nothing in the game itself.
objectives.detail: Measure the exterior GLB, the v3 greybox and the code-built interior: triangles, meshes, draw calls, materials, texture sizes, node count per room (tools/measure_load_time.gd, tools/inspect_lighthouse.gd and `ger.py audit`). Record a fixed camera shot set with tools/shot_scene.gd: every room, the stairwell at four heights, the lamp room, the door from outside, and four close-ups of the tower and house walls. Write GERFramework/reports/lighthouse_finisher_baseline.md and keep the PNGs for the final comparison.
acceptance: baseline report with per-room triangle and draw-call counts
fixed shot list with images saved
every existing lighthouse test result recorded as the green baseline

checks.note: Verified by the headless tests and fixed-camera shots named in the acceptance list.

objectives.title: Stop the exterior mesh showing inside the interior
objectives.why_score: Named by the creator. Exterior triangles inside rooms break every view in the building. Not 9: it ruins the first thing the player sees indoors.
objectives.detail: Find every exterior (and island) triangle that sits inside the interior volume. The probes tools/probe_shards.gd, probe_tower_intruders.gd and probe_shell.gd already exist; extend them into a repeatable audit across all rooms and the stairwell. Fix by baking: carve the intruders out with the existing carve_oriented_any / carve_cylinders_any (collider_builder), or split the exterior into an outer skin plus a clean inner liner, so the interior is lined by interior geometry only. tower_radii.json and the window data stay the single sources for the wall profile. The exterior silhouette from outside must not change (compare shots). Throughout, the interior must still match the exterior model: floors, footprint and the measured door stay on the greybox alignment JSON values.
acceptance: probe reports zero exterior triangles inside any interior volume
exterior silhouette from outside unchanged against the baseline shots
test_interior_walk and test_spiral_down still pass
interior footprint still fits inside the exterior walls (match the exterior model's alignment JSON)

objectives.title: No rain inside the lighthouse
objectives.why_score: Named by the creator. Rain through a roof is the loudest 'unfinished' signal in the building. Not 9: it shows from the first step inside.
objectives.detail: Find the rain emitter (scripts/world/lighting_rig.gd, wave_system.gd and the weather settings) and make it indoor-aware: rain follows the player but is suppressed, faded or clipped while the player is inside the lighthouse volume (zone_trigger.gd Area3D zones already exist), with a short fade at the door, and still visible through open windows and the lamp-room glass. Optional storm detail: a few drips from window sills, with the Sound agent adding the matching emitters. Never raise the dynamic-light or particle budget.
acceptance: headless test: zero rain particles inside the interior volume at maximum storm
rain still falls outside, and at the open door threshold it fades rather than pops
rain stays correct in every phase

checks.note: Verified by the headless tests and fixed-camera shots named in the acceptance list.

objectives.title: One realistic stair standard, applied to every staircase
objectives.why_score: Named by the creator: the steps are inconsistent and unrealistic. Not 9: stairs are walked on every run of the loop.
objectives.detail: Write one stair spec (rise about 0.18 m, going about 0.26 m, nosing, 2.0 m minimum headroom, handrail only where the style needs it) in a data file, and a stair builder every staircase uses: the tower spiral, the basement spiral (spiral_down.gd), the house stairs and landing steps. Real stonework: solid wedge treads that bear into the wall, worn nosings and dips, a central newel or open eye, chamfered edges, landing windows. One continuous mesh per step is kept; collision stays smooth enough to walk. Keep the measured tower radius table.
acceptance: every staircase step rise and going within 5 percent of the spec, measured by a test
headroom at least 2.0 m the full length of every stair
a stair walk test goes up and down every staircase without catching
shots of every staircase against the concept art

objectives.title: Boiler: living flames in place of the red slab
objectives.why_score: Named by the creator. The boiler is the first hands-on job; a red slab undercuts it. Not 9: the player watches this fire every crossing.
objectives.detail: Replace the glow quad (coal_job.gd fire_glow, the firebox door glow) with a cel-shaded fire: a firebox ember bed (stepped emissive coals), 3-4 layered flame cards with a scrolling, stepped-alpha flame shader (or a small GPUParticles3D inside budget), a flickering OmniLight3D with a toon-stepped flicker, drifting sparks and a little heat shimmer at the door. The fire reads low before coal, grows with each of the six loads (existing coal_job states) and is full when the dynamo runs. Keep the node names the coal job drives. Hand the crackle emitter anchor to the Sound agent.
acceptance: no flat red slab remains; the flames move in the shots
fire intensity follows the coal job loads 0 to 6
light count and budget unchanged (test_interior_budget passes)
test_coal_job passes

objectives.title: Geometry and polygon optimisation
objectives.why_score: Named by the creator. A cheaper building is what lets the extra detail fit. Not 10: it supports the look rather than fixing a visible fault.
objectives.detail: Using the LHF-01 baseline: remove hidden faces (backs of boxes against walls, floors under floors), merge static meshes per room by material, use MultiMesh for repeated props (barrels, crates, books, balusters), share materials, set visibility ranges and room-level culling, keep collision to simple shapes, decimate any FAL mesh over budget. Set a triangle and draw-call budget per room and for the whole lighthouse and report before/after.
acceptance: per-room budget set and met
draw calls and triangles lower than the baseline with no visible loss
load time not worse than the baseline (measure_load_time)

objectives.title: Room-by-room rebuild of the poorly rendered rooms
objectives.why_score: Named by the creator: some rooms are poorly rendered. Not 10: depends on LHF-02, 04 and 08 landing first.
objectives.detail: Score each room against the Interior Plan V4 and the concept art with a rubric (surfaces, trim, dressing, lighting, scale, story read), then rebuild from the lowest score: basement, boiler room, coal store, entry vestibule and hallway, keeper's office, storage room, keeper's quarters (L1), control landing (L2), tower stair landings, lamp room. Each room ends with 3 hero shots and a score of at least 7.
acceptance: rubric table for every room written to reports
every room scores 7 or more in the assessor's re-score
3 hero shots per room saved

checks.note: Verified by the headless tests and fixed-camera shots named in the acceptance list.

objectives.title: Replace greybox props with real models or well-made procedural props
objectives.why_score: Named by the creator: some props are basic greybox. Not 10: FAL generation costs credits and needs the creator's go-ahead.
objectives.detail: List every prop in rooms_house.gd and rooms_tower.gd that is still a primitive box or cylinder (beds, desk, shelves, chart table, stove, tub, crates, barrels, coats, tools, books, paperwork). First reuse the models already in Assets/Models/prop (lhi_boiler, lhi_arc_lamp, lhi_coal_shovel, lhi_flighted_poster, the burner models) where they fit, then build the rest as cheap bevelled or lathed procedural meshes with proper materials. Where a FAL model is truly better, write the submission and run only `main_asset.py --check-only`; real generation waits for the creator. 2048 texture rule applies; collision boxes and interaction anchors are kept.
acceptance: no primitive-box furniture left in any room
new .glb files have the import script set and 2048 textures
anchors and collision unchanged (test_interior_anchors passes)

checks.note: Verified by the headless tests and fixed-camera shots named in the acceptance list.

objectives.decision: May I run real FAL generation (costs credits) for props where procedural meshes are not good enough, or stay with reused models and procedural props only?

objectives.title: Reset the Flighted posters
objectives.why_score: Named by the creator. Posters are the canon dread in the entry. Not 10: they are small, but they are the first lore the player reads.
objectives.detail: Remove the current posters (rooms_house.gd _poster; poster.gd stays as the interaction) and rebuild: crude black, silver and navy letterpress on aged paper (prompts in Docs/Lore Build/factions/fac_flighted.md), a dark sphere eclipsing a silver moon over waves, the slogans THEY BRING THE STORMS and THEY CHANGE THE SEASONS, three sizes (0.72 x 1.0 m base), pasted with torn corners, wheat-paste drips, curl and overlap, decal depth so nothing z-fights, placed where the sightlines make the player see them. Use the lhi_flighted_poster model or a decal with a hand-made texture. Ask the creator if the poster count or placement should differ.
acceptance: old posters removed
posters match the canon faction brief, with no retired brand text
no z-fighting at any viewing angle
poster interaction still works

checks.note: Verified by the headless tests and fixed-camera shots named in the acceptance list.

objectives.decision: How many posters, where, and any slogans beyond the two canon lines? Should they stay readable up close (legible text) or be pure graphic?

objectives.title: Cel-shaded look for the whole lighthouse
objectives.why_score: Named by the creator: realistic yet cel-shaded. The look decision is the creator's. Not 10: it multiplies the others rather than fixing a fault.
objectives.detail: Agree one toon look with the Lighting agent so interior and exterior match: stepped light ramp, a restrained ink outline on large silhouettes and props (none on fine stonework), the desaturated stone palette from the style guide with amber and gold accents, painted-grain textures. Build it as one shared material set (interior kit.gd and the exterior) and a before/after sample for the creator to approve before applying everywhere.
acceptance: the creator signs off a sample room
interior and exterior share the same toon ramp
performance not worse than the baseline

checks.note: Verified by the headless tests and fixed-camera shots named in the acceptance list.

objectives.decision: Approve the toon look sample (ramp steps, outline weight, palette) before it is applied to the whole lighthouse.

objectives.title: Exterior walls: close-up realism
objectives.why_score: Named by the creator. Not 9: the exterior reads from the sea; the close-up only matters at the door and walkway.
objectives.detail: From the baseline close-ups: add close-range stone detail (a triplanar stone, mortar and weathering overlay, a height or normal map, a streak and salt-stain mask) blended in only within a few metres, bevel and reveal the window and door openings, add the stringcourses, lintels, sills and base plinth the concept art shows, clean stretched or smeared texture areas. Keep the silhouette and the 2048 texture. If the baked texture is the problem, regenerating the exterior with FAL costs credits and stays the creator's call.
acceptance: close-up shots of tower and house walls show mortar, bevel and weathering
the silhouette at distance matches the baseline
exterior mesh_audit passes
objectives.decision: If painted close-up detail cannot fix the exterior walls, do you want the exterior regenerated with FAL (credits), or kept as the v3 baked texture with overlays only?

objectives.title: Windows, doors and thresholds: one consistent opening kit
objectives.why_score: Openings are where inside meets outside, and where the two models currently disagree. Not 9: only eight windows plus the door.
objectives.detail: Make every opening share a kit that reads the same from both sides: stone reveals with thickness matching the wall, sills and lintels, iron mullions and believable glass, door frame, threshold stone and the door. Driven by data/world/lighthouse_windows.json and the bake tools.
acceptance: all eight windows and the main door use the kit from both sides
no gap, light leak or see-through between wall and frame
test_sightlines still passes

checks.note: Verified by the headless tests and fixed-camera shots named in the acceptance list.

objectives.detail: Finish the lantern room: Fresnel lens bands, the arc lamp, iron glazing bars, gallery rail and floor, a clear view over the landscape, a lit-beacon look with the Lighting agent. Keep the LampSocket and the Lens_* node names the lamp scripts use.

lens, glass and rail shots against concept art
view is unobstructed to the ship route and island rock

objectives.detail: With the Lighting agent: per-room light plans (amber lamps, cold window light, firelight), light cards and emissive materials in place of extra dynamic lights, correct for every phase, never exceeding the interior light budget.
acceptance: test_interior_lights and test_interior_budget pass
each room's light reads in ISLAND, OUTBOUND, RETURN and BEACON_RELIT

objectives.detail: Add beams and joists that respect the stairwell, stained ceiling plaster, skirting boards, door and window architraves, floor board or flagstone layouts per room, chimney breast and flue, stove pipes, cables and pipes in the basement.
